news.title:
Sula Vineyards' promoter stake rises to 24.6% as CEO Rajeev Samant buys shares, signaling confidence in growth prospects.
Sula leverages strong brand, premiumization, and wine tourism to lead India's growing wine market amid evolving consumer trends.

Sula Vineyards' board approved sale of its registered office for Rs. 27 Cr.
Post-sale, the registered office will shift within the same building from July 2026.
SULA: Upcoming Results And Dividend Outlook Will Support Positive View
news.body: The analyst price target for Sula Vineyards has been adjusted from ₹201.50 to ₹196.50 as analysts factor in updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E expectations. What's in the News The board recorded the resignation of Chief Financial Officer Abhishek Kapoor.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 27%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2027 has deteriorated. 2027 revenue forecast decreased from ₹6.40b to ₹6.15b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹8.04 per share to ₹5.83 per share. Net income forecast to grow 91% next year vs 18% growth forecast for Beverage industry in India. Consensus price target down from ₹202 to ₹197. Share price fell 5.1% to ₹165 over the past week.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.04 (down from ₹8.32 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹6.01b (up 3.7% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹256.5m (down 64% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 4.3% (down from 12% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 1.6%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 17%. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.0% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 8.3% growth forecast for the Beverage industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 30% per year whereas the company’s share price has fallen by 26% per year.
